text:
elaine (eng-sec): FYI incoming intake from the OrionHealth POC — they want a completed CAIQ v3 + SOC2 evidence and a network diagram by EOD Fri. Sales asked if we can also confirm SAML/SCIM support and residual data handling.

sam (sales): @elaine thanks. Customer is evaluating Redwood Hosted + Dedicated fallback. Procurement pushed a hard deadline. They also asked price for an annual Dedicated commit (rough numbers ok).

mike (solutions): @sam do we have the exact CAIQ template variant they want? sometimes enterprise security teams attach custom sections.

sam (sales): They attached a standard CAIQ spreadsheet and a short questionnaire (6 Qs) about data residency & encryption. Putting both in the deal thread.

jordan (legal): We should confirm whether they need the SOC2 report under NDA or via our portal. Also, any contractual redlines on data use? I can start the NDA if needed.

elaine (eng-sec): Quick checklist from our side: 1) Pre-filled CAIQ in Confluence (link pasted in thread) 2) SOC2 type II report (2024) available via secure link after NDA 3) Pen test summary + remediation plan (Q4 2024) 4) Network diagram (internal infra + VPC peering options) 5) SAML + SCIM supported, SCIM write provisioning limited to admin groups.

nina (prod): For Hosted vs Dedicated: hosted keeps customer data in tenant isolation; Dedicated gives physical GPU pools and dedicated network controls. If they require on-prem or VPC-hosted, that'll shift lead time and certs.

elaine (eng-sec): Which items need engineering action now: - complete CAIQ cells flagged "partial" - capture evidence links for encryption at rest/in-transit - export network diagram (current) - produce short note on fallbacks and data flow between Redwood control plane and customer resources

mike (solutions): I'll take the CAIQ partial answers and draft the evidence links. @elaine can you export the VPC/network diagram from the infra repo and attach?

elaine (eng-sec): Yep, will pull diagram. also: watch out for question about KMS/HSM — we have both KMS integrations documented; HSM partners require enterprise plan.

security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 link requires nda_signed == true. Use /get-soc2-link <deal-id> to fetch.

sam (sales): Deal id: DH-2026-177. NDA sent to buyer; they indicated they'll sign by tomorrow.

jordan (legal): Great. once NDA is in place i'll get the SOC2 portal link and vendor attestation docs.

ops-oncall: small note — if they request Dedicated in us-west-2 single AZ we need a capacity check. Might delay by 2-3 weeks. Tagging eng-runtime.

elaine (eng-sec): For CAIQ answers where we say "partial" we need a short remediation note + expected timeline. I'll mark the rows where product changes are needed.

mike (solutions): Drafting a one-page summary for procurement: includes SOC2 date, pen-test date, SAML/SCIM support, encryption details, KMS options, and Dedicated commit pricing ballpark. Will post shortly.

sam (sales): Thanks all. Can we aim to have the CAIQ + summary + network diagram in this thread by Thu EOD so procurement can review before Friday? :crossed_fingers:

elaine (eng-sec): Yes. I'll upload diagram and initial CAIQ diffs by Wed.

nina (prod): If provisioning Dedicated we should flag required IP allowlist steps for customer infra team — I can write the short runbook.

mike (solutions): Putting action items: [Mike] complete CAIQ answers, [Elaine] diagram + evidence, [Nina] runbook for IP allowlist, [Jordan] SOC2 link after NDA, [Ops] capacity check.

sam (sales): Perfect. i'll update the customer and push for NDA signature. thanks team :thumbsup:
